data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English elements 'baeg' meaning 'a bridge' and 'brig' meaning 'bright' or 'fair'. This name was given to babies born near a bridge or to represent a connection or passage from one place to another. The name Bainbridge carries the meaning “Bright or fair bridge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bainbridge usually hope their child will grow to embody bright or fair bridge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
